title: Citadel Theatre

services.name: Show ticket
services.desc: A Season Ticket Package allows you to experience live theatre presentations of your choice at the Citadel Theatre. You can witness theatre talent while saving, compared to purchasing tickets one show at a time. Can’t commit to all six shows? We offer My Main 4, and My Main 3 season ticket packages for the upcoming season at the best price! All Season Ticket Package Holders are entitled to a range of benefits and offers from our partner businesses in Edmonton’s Arts District. Whether you want the full season experience with Mainstage 6 or just a few favourites, our Season Ticket Packages offer the best value and the best seats. services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Zeidler Hall is one of our theatres that allow your guests to bring in both food and beverages. Zeidler Hall is available for rentals as short as 4 hours, up do multi day events, depending on availability. Located on the third floor of the building, the Citadel Boardroom can comfortably seat 16 people around its large central table. Additional seating in the room can bring the maximum capacity to 39 guests. The Boardroom’s south facing windows let in lots of natural light, making it an inviting place to hold your meeting, conference call or training workshop.
